decision: DECISIONS (bb) - wet-lab-preparation UTR benchmark pool, assertion-first curation per docs/ANCHORS.md
purpose: Clinical/published UTR references admitted to every full-length mRNA design pool. Sequences were extracted programmatically from the cited primary sources (zero manual transcription); each entry is verified at load time (length, md5, ACGU purity, and passage of the U1/U2 admission rules of agent_core.generation.utr_pool).

entries.label: BNT162b2 5'UTR (alpha-globin-derived, template-verified 51-nt form)
sources: GenBank PP544446.1 (Vector BNT162b2 clone Vacc_Batch_FP9359, complete sequence; Raoult direct submission 2024) - interval between the annotated T7 promoter end (position 3526) and the BNT162b2 CDS start (position 3578), T->U
Xia & Lim 2021 Vaccines 9:734 sec 3.3.2 + Fig 2A: BNT162b2 5'UTR = human alpha-globin 5'UTR (shared by HBA1/HBA2) with the Kozak consensus optimized to GCCACCAUG
NCBI RefSeq NM_000558.5 (HBA1) 5'UTR core cross-match: CTTCTGGTCCCCACAGACTCAGAGAGAACC[C->G]CCACC

entries.label: BNT162b2 3'UTR AES-mtRNR1 (99-nt form, LinearDesign-supplement verbatim)
sources: LinearDesign Nature 2023 supplement (Zhang et al., 10.1038/s41586-023-06127-z), 'The 5' and 3' UTR sequences used in the COVID mRNA vaccine experiments' - 3'UTR block, verbatim (identical block repeated in the VZV gE section)
Xia & Lim 2021 Vaccines 9:734 sec 3.5: BNT162b2 3'UTR comprises AES/TLE5 and mtRNR1 segments (AES-derived 5' portion + mtRNR1-derived 3' portion)

entries.label: LinearDesign Nature-2023 COVID-construct 5'UTR (synthetic leader, supplement verbatim)
sources: LinearDesign Nature 2023 supplement, COVID mRNA vaccine experiments 5'UTR block, verbatim (T->U); a Moderna-style synthetic leader ending in the GCCACC Kozak

entries.label: Human alpha-globin HBA1 natural 5'UTR (RefSeq NM_000558.5)
sources: NCBI RefSeq NM_000558.5 (Homo sapiens hemoglobin subunit alpha 1, mRNA) 5'UTR, 37 nt
NCBI RefSeq NM_000517.5 (HBA2) 5'UTR shared suffix - identical (Xia & Lim 2021: '5'-UTR is identical between human HBA1 and HBA2')

entries.label: Human alpha-globin HBA1 natural 3'UTR (RefSeq NM_000558.5)
sources: NCBI RefSeq NM_000517.5 (HBA2) 3'UTR paralogue consistency (shared prefix/suffix)
Xia & Lim 2021 Vaccines 9:734 sec 3.4: mRNA-1273 uses 'the 110-nt 3'-UTR of human alpha-globin gene (HBA1)'

notes: bnt162b2_5utr: the template-verified 51-nt form is used. The repo anchor data/benchmarks/external_anchors/vaccine_mrna/bnt162b2_full.fa and the 2021 decoded-transcript assemblies carry a 3-nt 5' GAG prefix before this sequence; the PP544446 batch-plasmid template does not encode it, so it is treated as an assembly artifact and excluded.

bnt162b2_3utr: the 94-nt AES-mtRNR1 form is the verbatim sequence published (and used unmodified-nucleotide wet-lab validated) in the LinearDesign Nature 2023 supplement; Xia & Lim 2021 describe the full BNT162b2 3'UTR as longer AES(136-nt)+mtRNR1(139-nt) segments, for which no verbatim authoritative public sequence is available - the LinearDesign-published form is used and disclosed.
hba1_3utr length is 111 nt from NM_000558.5; mRNA-1273's patent design uses a 110-nt HBA1 3'UTR (Xia & Lim 2021) - the natural RefSeq form is used here.
